title: Incorrigible

inlines.v: INCOR'RIGIBLE, adjective [Latin corrigo; con and rego.] 1. That cannot be corrected or amended; bad beyond correction; as incorrigible error. 2. Too depraved to be corrected or reformed; as an incorrigible sinner; an incorrigible drunkard.
